name: sc-corporate-income-tax
description: Seychelles business tax for tax year 2026 for companies, sole traders and partnerships: 15% and 25% bands, the 25% and 33% regulated sector rate, presumptive tax at 1.5%, virtual asset licensees, withholding tax on payments to non-residents, deduction at source, PAYG, the 31 March return, Tax Agent Lodgment dates and penalties. Use for Seychelles corporate tax rate, presumptive tax, business tax return due date, or withholding tax on dividends and interest. Source-based; no accountant has signed it.
